scope: First batch of internet multiplayer stability fixes; gameplay collision policy intentionally unchanged

changes: Added monotonic render-time cursor to prevent adaptive-buffer playback reversal
Rejected same/abnormally short sample intervals for extrapolation
Separated player and enemy hot snapshots onto ENet channels 1 and 2
Added independent hot snapshot sequence numbers and reliable world snapshot stale-packet rejection
Added 320-byte Variant budget fallback for low-frequency player fields; omitted fields use null and do not overwrite client state
Stopped Host from continuing stale remote input after 0.20 seconds without an update
Explicitly allocated three ENet channels for reliable, player-hot, and enemy-hot traffic
Adapted reliable snapshot argument and made facing regression submit input across the input-expiry window
Added same-timestamp extrapolation and monotonic-render checks
Changed failed checks to return a non-zero exit code

verification.godot_headless_quit: passed; existing ObjectDB/resource-leak exit warnings remain
